description: This file defines a mapping profile using AutoMapper for converting domain entities (CatalogItem, CatalogType, CatalogBrand) to their respective Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) within the PublicApi namespace.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper's Profile, configuring object-object mappings between entity models and DTOs.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor configuring AutoMapper mappings for CatalogItem, CatalogType, and CatalogBrand entities to their DTO counterparts.

calls: CreateMap<CatalogType, CatalogTypeDto>().ForMember(dto => dto.Name, options => options.MapFrom(src => src.Type))
CreateMap<CatalogBrand, CatalogBrandDto>().ForMember(dto => dto.Name, options => options.MapFrom(src => src.Brand))
